heading.en: Where to stay in and around Garmisch

queriedAt.zh: 2026 年 10 月 23 日晚（柏林时间）

intro.zh: 条件：每晚 50€（含所有费用），必须有厨房，房型不限；Booking ≥8.0、Airbnb ≥4.5，评价都 ≥15 条；周边村镇公交单程 ≤60 分钟、最多换乘 1 次。时刻按 2027 年 1 月 15 日（周五）查。
intro.en: Criteria: €50 per night all-in, a kitchen is required, any room type; Booking ≥8.0, Airbnb ≥4.5, at least 15 reviews each; nearby villages within 60 minutes one way by public transport, at most 1 change. Timetables checked for Friday 15 January 2027.

items.zh: 没有一家同时满足全部条件。整个 1 小时圈里，有厨房、评分达标的房源最低约 62€/晚（3 晚 186€），比预算高 24%。下面列的是最接近的几家，每家都标了差在哪里。
items.en: Nothing meets every criterion. Across the whole 1-hour radius, the cheapest well-rated place with a kitchen is about €62/night (€186 for 3 nights), 24% over budget. Below are the closest options, each with what it misses.

items.zh: 最接近：1 · Murnau 的独立房间，62€/晚。可以用房东的厨房和客厅。Murnau 坐 RB 24 分钟直达 Garmisch，末班车 23:07，Deutschlandticket 免费。
items.en: Closest: 1 · A private room in Murnau, €62/night. Use of the host's kitchen and living room. Murnau to Garmisch is a direct 24-minute RB ride, last train 23:07, free with the Deutschlandticket.

items.zh: 想要整套公寓：3 · Klais 的 40 m² 公寓，65€/晚。有完整厨房，到 Klais 站步行约 10 分钟，RB 13 分钟到 Garmisch，末班车 00:02。
items.en: If you want a whole flat: 3 · A 40 m² flat in Klais, €65/night. Full kitchen, about 10 minutes' walk to Klais station, 13 minutes by RB to Garmisch, last train 00:02.

items.zh: 想住在 Garmisch 本镇：4 · Appartement im Hasental，65€/晚（Booking 公开价）。你登录 Genius 后如果有 8% 以上的折扣，就能进到 60€ 以内。
items.en: To stay in Garmisch itself: 4 · Appartement im Hasental, €65/night (Booking public rate). If your Genius login gives 8% or more off, it drops under €60.

items.zh: 唯一在预算内的：Uffing 湖边小屋，42€/晚，有厨房。评分 5.0，但只有 12 条评价，所以放在「差点入选」。Uffing 坐 RB 29 分钟直达 Garmisch。
items.en: The only one in budget: a lakeside cabin in Uffing, €42/night, with kitchen. Rated 5.0 but only 12 reviews, so it's under "Near misses". Uffing to Garmisch is a direct 29-minute RB ride.

alerts.zh: 已用第 3 步补充搜索：Hostelworld 和德国私人度假屋平台 traum-ferienwohnungen.de。后者在 Zugspitzland 最便宜的 Ferienwohnung 也是 195€/3 晚。
alerts.en: Step 3 fallback search was used: Hostelworld and the German private holiday-flat site traum-ferienwohnungen.de. The cheapest Ferienwohnung there in the Zugspitz area is still €195 for 3 nights.

alerts.zh: 价格都不含城市税（Kurbeitrag）：Garmisch 3€/天，Grainau 3.50€/天，其他村子要到店确认。交了城市税会拿到游客卡，当地公交免费。
alerts.en: Prices exclude the tourist tax (Kurbeitrag): Garmisch €3/day, Grainau €3.50/day, other villages to be confirmed on arrival. Paying it gets you a guest card with free local buses.

guestCard.zh: 电子游客卡：当地公交免费
guestCard.en: Digital guest card: free local buses

guestCard.zh: GaPa–Grainau–Eibsee 公交和齿轨火车免费
guestCard.en: Free GaPa–Grainau–Eibsee buses and cog railway

guestCard.zh: Alpenwelt Karwendel 卡：冬季公交、越野滑雪道免费
guestCard.en: Alpenwelt Karwendel card: free winter buses and cross-country trails

guestCard.zh: Alpenwelt Karwendel 卡：冬季公交、越野滑雪道免费
guestCard.en: Alpenwelt Karwendel card: free winter buses and cross-country trails

guestCard.zh: Alpenwelt Karwendel 卡：冬季公交、越野滑雪道免费
guestCard.en: Alpenwelt Karwendel card: free winter buses and cross-country trails

townsNote.zh: 火车时刻来自 ÖBB 时刻表（含 DB 数据，已有 2027 年 1 月的班次）；公交时刻来自 Google 地图，页面提示「时刻表可能不是最新」，出发前到 RVO 或 DB 核实。班次频率是按白天几个时段抽查的大概值。地图上的村镇和住宿坐标是村镇中心/大致位置，不是每家房源的精确门牌，预订前以 Booking/Airbnb 页面上的地图为准。
townsNote.en: Train times from the ÖBB timetable (includes DB data, already has January 2027 services); bus times from Google Maps, which warned the timetable may be out of date, so check RVO or DB before you go. Frequencies are approximate, sampled at a few daytime slots. Village and stay coordinates on the map are village centres or rough locations, not exact addresses; use the map on Booking/Airbnb before booking.

walk.zh: 到 Murnau 站步行约 15 分钟
walk.en: About 15 min walk to Murnau station

summary.zh: 房东 Diana 是做了 13 年的超赞房东。房间安静，可以用厨房和客厅，离步行街 5 分钟。
summary.en: Diana has been a Superhost for 13 years. Quiet room, use of the kitchen and living room, 5 minutes from the pedestrian street.

notes.zh: 同一位房东同价还有 一间单人间（4.9，126 条评价）。
notes.en: The same host has a single room at the same price (4.9, 126 reviews).

stays.name: Private room with garden in Murnau

walk.zh: 到 Murnau 站步行约 15 分钟
walk.en: About 15 min walk to Murnau station

summary.zh: 和第 1 家是同一位房东。可以用厨房、壁炉房、阳光房和花园，评价数最多（218 条）。
summary.en: Same host as #1. Use of the kitchen, fireplace room, sunroom and garden; the most reviews (218).

walk.zh: 到 Klais 站步行约 7–10 分钟，公交站约 100 m
walk.en: About 7–10 min walk to Klais station, bus stop about 100 m

cancel.zh: 12 月 16 日前免费取消，1 月 8 日前部分退款
cancel.en: Free cancellation until 16 Dec, partial refund until 8 Jan

summary.zh: Klais 小村边上的独栋房子二楼，一室一厅带厨房。村里只有一家餐馆，加油站早上 7 点起能买面包和少量食品，买菜最好在 Garmisch 或 Mittenwald 买好带回来。
summary.en: Upper floor of a detached house at the edge of tiny Klais: living room, bedroom and kitchen. The village has one restaurant; the petrol station sells bread and basics from 7 a.m., so it's best to shop in Garmisch or Mittenwald and bring it back.

walk.zh: 到 Garmisch 站 1.5 km（约 20 分钟），凭游客卡可坐当地公交
walk.en: 1.5 km to Garmisch station (about 20 min); local buses free with guest card

cancel.zh: 2027 年 1 月 10 日前免费取消

summary.zh: 有冰箱、烤箱、灶台和咖啡机，带露台和山景。房间很小，一个人住刚好。
summary.en: Fridge, oven, hob and coffee machine, with a terrace and mountain view. Very small; just right for one.

note.zh: 公开价，登录 Genius 后可能更低
note.en: Public rate; may be lower when logged in with Genius

type.zh: 独立房间（独立浴室），带阳台

tag.zh: 评分最高 · 厨房待确认

walk.en: Not stated; ask the host before booking

summary.zh: 评分最高（4.97，91 条）。搜索时按「厨房」筛选出来的，但房源页的设施列表里没看到厨房，预订前问清楚。回 Wallgau 的末班车 20:35，晚上活动受限。
summary.en: Highest rated (4.97, 91 reviews). It came up with the "kitchen" filter, but no kitchen is listed in the amenities, so ask before booking. The last bus back to Wallgau is 20:35, which limits evenings.

staysNote.zh: 3 晚总价 ÷ 3 = 每晚价格。Airbnb 价格已含清洁费和服务费；Booking 价格写着「含税费」，但城市税通常到店另交。
staysNote.en: Total for 3 nights ÷ 3 = price per night. Airbnb prices include cleaning and service fees; Booking says "taxes included", but the tourist tax is usually paid on arrival.

why.zh: 评分 5.0，有厨房，价格在预算内，但只有 12 条评价（要求 ≥15）。独立房间、共用浴室，1 月 14 日前免费取消。到 Uffing 站的距离房东没写，预订前问一下。
why.en: Rated 5.0, has a kitchen and is within budget, but only 12 reviews (15 required). Private room, shared bathroom, free cancellation until 14 Jan. The host doesn't say how far Uffing station is; ask before booking.

why.zh: Booking 8.8（1,299 条）、Hostelworld 9.4，就在火车站对面，含早餐，但没有客用厨房。要有 DJH 青旅会员卡。
why.en: Booking 8.8 (1,299 reviews), Hostelworld 9.4, right opposite the station, breakfast included, but no guest kitchen. Requires a DJH youth-hostel membership card.

why.zh: Airbnb 4.86（202 条），有厨房，但比预算高 34%。
why.en: Airbnb 4.86 (202 reviews), has a kitchen, but 34% over budget.

note.zh: Garmisch-Classic 雪场（Hausberg、Kreuzeck、Alpspitze）从 Garmisch 坐公交就到；1 月是滑雪季。
note.en: The Garmisch-Classic ski area (Hausberg, Kreuzeck, Alpspitze) is a bus ride from Garmisch; January is peak season.

lang.en: Private lessons in German or English

how.zh: 开了 75 年的老牌滑雪学校；Google 4.6（751 条）
how.en: A ski school running for 75 years; Google 4.6 (751 reviews)

kind.zh: 雪道上的入门课（1 天）
kind.en: Beginner course on the pistes (1 day)

where.en: Meet at the bottom of the Hausbergbahn, 08:30

how.zh: 至少 5 人成团；还有 2 天的 Kreuzeck 入门课 249€
how.en: Runs with at least 5 people; there's also a 2-day Kreuzeck beginner course for €249

where.en: Kreuzeck, staying at the Kreuzeckhaus mountain hut

how.zh: 含雪崩搜救装备和山屋住宿半膳，价格看官网
how.en: Avalanche rescue kit and half-board hut stay included; see the website for price

note.zh: 住 Klais、Mittenwald、Wallgau 的话，Alpenwelt Karwendel 游客卡可以免费用越野滑雪道。
note.en: If you stay in Klais, Mittenwald or Wallgau, the Alpenwelt Karwendel guest card gives free use of the cross-country trails.

how.en: Small groups and private lessons only

kind.en: Beginner snowshoe hike up the Eckbauer

level.en: Able to walk uphill for 1–2 hours

how.zh: Google 4.9（379 条）；Grainau 游客卡在部分行程有 9 折
how.en: Google 4.9 (379 reviews); 10% off some tours with the Grainau guest card

kind.en: Day trip, snowshoes and poles included

note.zh: 从 Kreuzeck、Osterfelderkopf、Wank 起飞，冬天能不能飞看天气和缆车，预约时确认。
note.en: Launches from Kreuzeck, Osterfelderkopf and Wank; winter flying depends on weather and lifts, so confirm when booking.

how.zh: 住宿交了城市税就有游客卡，活动表在各地旅游局官网
how.en: You get a guest card once your stay pays the tourist tax; programmes are on each tourist office's website

kind.zh: 当地阿尔卑斯协会分会

how.zh: 团体活动大多要求是会员；抱石馆是他们开的
how.en: Most group activities are members-only; they run the bouldering gym

start.zh: 环线，起点在 Eibsee 站（齿轨火车 / 公交，凭 Grainau 游客卡免费）
start.en: Loop starting at Eibsee station (cog railway / bus, free with the Grainau guest card)

season.zh: 冬季环湖路一般能走，可能结冰，带简易冰爪
season.en: The lakeside path is usually walkable in winter but can be icy; bring microspikes

hikes.name: Partnach Gorge and Graseck Loop Trail

start.zh: 环线，起点在 Olympia 滑雪场，从 Garmisch 站坐当地公交或步行
start.en: Loop from the Olympic ski stadium, by local bus or on foot from Garmisch station

season.zh: 峡谷全年开放（10–5 月 8:00–18:00），冬天有冰挂；峡谷后往 Vordergraseck 的路施工封闭到 2026-11-20
season.en: The gorge is open all year (Oct–May 8:00–18:00) with icicles in winter; the path beyond it towards Vordergraseck is closed for works until 2026-11-20

hikes.name: The Isar Nature Adventure Trail near Krün

start.zh: Krün，坐去 Wallgau 的 329 路公交

season.zh: 低海拔，冬天可走，有雪时更慢
season.en: Low altitude, fine in winter, slower in snow

start.zh: Krün，坐 329 路公交；住 Klais 的话离几个湖更近
start.en: Krün, by bus 329; closer to the lakes if you stay in Klais

start.zh: 起点在 Ammer 河谷，公交怎么到没查
start.en: Starts in the Ammer valley; transit access not checked

season.zh: 冬天河谷路段可能结冰
season.en: The valley path can be icy in winter

name.en: Höllentalklamm to the Höllentalangerhütte and back

season.zh: 冬季关闭，桥会拆掉，约 5 月底重开。夏天再来时的首选
season.en: Closed in winter: the bridges are removed and it reopens around the end of May. Top pick for a summer visit

hikesNote.zh: 来自 komoot「Garmisch-Partenkirchen 县最受欢迎的徒步路线」。同一页上评分很高的 Leutascher Geisterklamm（4.7，1,843 条）冬季整段封闭；Kofel、Notkarspitze 是需要高山经验的困难路线，1 月不推荐，所以都没列。
hikesNote.en: From komoot's "most popular hikes in Garmisch-Partenkirchen district". The highly rated Leutascher Geisterklamm on the same page (4.7, 1,843 votes) is closed in winter; Kofel and Notkarspitze are hard routes needing alpine experience and aren't advisable in January, so they're left out.

paragraphs.zh: 假设：预算是每晚总价（含清洁费和服务费），城市税单独算；「有厨房」包括可以用房东厨房的独立房间。预算内 45–55€，浮动区间 40–60€。
paragraphs.en: Assumptions: the budget is the all-in price per night (cleaning and service fees included), tourist tax counted separately; "kitchen" includes private rooms with use of the host's kitchen. In budget €45–55, stretch range €40–60.

paragraphs.zh: Booking 用了「评分 8+」和「厨房」筛选并按价格排序，每个村镇单独搜：Garmisch、Grainau、Farchant、Mittenwald、Krün、Murnau、Oberammergau、Ehrwald。Booking 把「Oberau」识别成了 Oberaudorf（另一个地方），Oberau 的 Booking 结果没查到。
paragraphs.en: Booking was searched per village with the "8+ rating" and "kitchen" filters, sorted by price: Garmisch, Grainau, Farchant, Mittenwald, Krün, Murnau, Oberammergau, Ehrwald. Booking resolved "Oberau" to Oberaudorf (a different place), so there are no Booking results for Oberau.

paragraphs.zh: Airbnb 用了「厨房」筛选、3 晚总价 ≤200€，按 Garmisch、Mittenwald、Murnau 搜；Airbnb 的搜索范围很大，结果里一半是 1 小时圈外的房源（Füssen、Schongau、Penzberg 等），都排除了。
paragraphs.en: Airbnb was searched with the "kitchen" filter and a 3-night total ≤ €200 for Garmisch, Mittenwald and Murnau; its search area is very wide and half the results were outside the 1-hour radius (Füssen, Schongau, Penzberg, etc.), all excluded.

paragraphs.zh: 补充搜索：Hostelworld（moun10 没有客用厨房）、traum-ferienwohnungen.de（Zugspitzland 最便宜 195€/3 晚）。Google 酒店价格没查。
paragraphs.en: Fallback search: Hostelworld (moun10 has no guest kitchen), traum-ferienwohnungen.de (cheapest in the Zugspitz area €195 for 3 nights). Google hotel prices were not checked.

paragraphs.zh: Booking 的价格是未登录的公开价，你登录 Genius 后可能更低，Garmisch 的 Hasental 小公寓最有可能因此进入 60€ 以内。
paragraphs.en: Booking prices are public rates seen logged out; your Genius login may show less, which could bring the Hasental studio in Garmisch under €60.
